title: Visual Mode (v)
instruction_text:
Select text visually before operating on it!

'v' = enter visual mode (character selection)
'h,j,k,l' = extend selection
'd' = delete selection
'y' = yank (copy) selection

Your task: Delete the bracketed text.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to '['
2. Press 'v' to enter visual mode
3. Press 'l' repeatedly to select '[DELETE THIS PART]'
4. Press 'd' to delete the selection
5. Save and quit with :wq
